class.name: CgamePerfStats
class.brief_description: Rolling statistics over fixed-size ring buffers.
class.description: [CgamePerfStats] stores named series of floating-point samples, such as frame time or draw calls, in fixed-capacity ring buffers. Pushing a sample never allocates once the series exists. Older samples are overwritten when the capacity is reached. Statistics are computed over the newest samples: all of them, or the last [code]window[/code] samples. Percentiles use linear interpolation. Non-finite values are ignored. [codeblock] var stats = CgamePerfStats.new() stats.push("frame_ms", delta * 1000.0) print(stats.percentile("frame_ms", 95.0, 300)) [/codeblock]

method.name: average
method.description: Returns the mean of the newest [param window] samples of [param series] (all when [code]0[/code]), or [code]0.0[/code] if there are none.

method.name: count
method.description: Returns the number of samples currently stored for [param series].

method.name: has_series
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a sample was pushed to [param series].

method.name: last
method.description: Returns the newest sample of [param series], or [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: max_value
method.description: Returns the largest of the newest [param window] samples (floored at [code]0.0[/code]).

method.name: names
method.description: Returns the names of all series in the order they were created.

method.name: percentile
method.description: Returns the linearly interpolated percentile ([code]0..100[/code]) of the newest [param window] samples, or [code]0.0[/code] if there are none.

method.name: push
method.description: Appends [param value] to [param series], creating it if needed. Non-finite values are ignored.

method.name: series
method.description: Returns the newest [param window] samples (all when [code]0[/code]) from oldest to newest.

method.name: summary
method.description: Returns [code]{last, avg, p50, p95, p99, max, samples}[/code] for [param series].

method.name: total_pushed
method.description: Returns how many samples were ever pushed to [param series], including overwritten ones.

members.member: Number of samples a series keeps. It applies to series created after the change.
